universities.summary: Shiv Nadar University Chennai is a private university at Kalavakkam in Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu. Its 2026 new-entry portfolio includes former SSN engineering and management programmes under SNU Chennai, alongside commerce and economics. These awards and admission routes are distinct from legacy SSN continuing cohorts and Shiv Nadar University in Greater Noida.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Kalavakkam campus on Old Mahabalipuram Road has teaching laboratories, library services, student clubs and sporting facilities. Undergraduate students choose university hostel accommodation or university transport. Programme laboratories and project work connect classroom study with campus practical activity; the exact department and timetable determine daily use of these facilities.
universities.cityProfile: Kalavakkam is on Rajiv Gandhi Salai, also called Old Mahabalipuram Road, in Chengalpattu district south of Chennai. The university address is Kalavakkam 603110. Travel planning should use this campus address rather than a central Chennai location; university transport and campus accommodation are the undergraduate commuting options.
universities.practicalExposure: Engineering programmes combine laboratory and project study with computing and specialist applications. Commerce regulations offer a sixth-semester accounting-firm or business/NGO internship route, or approved campus electives. The accounting-firm option requires the ICAI Intermediate qualification. Curriculum and internship requirements do not guarantee a job or professional certification.
universities.hostelOverview: Undergraduates must select university hostel accommodation or university transport. First-year undergraduate hostel rooms are shared. The 2026-27 schedule lists shared non-AC room rent from INR 85,000 annually, with separate refundable deposits and hostel admission charges; attached-bathroom and AC categories cost more. Electricity and mess costs require separate confirmation before budgeting.
universities.dietarySupport: Campus accommodation and dining arrangements should be discussed together when obtaining a room quotation. The reviewed fee table does not establish a complete mess charge or a guaranteed dietary menu. Tell the university about allergies, religious food requirements or other dietary needs before accepting an accommodation allocation.
universities.safetyOverview: The university publishes anti-ragging arrangements, an Internal Complaints Committee, a student grievance committee and anti-drug committee. Its student counselling service provides a support route for personal concerns. Confirm current contact details and the appropriate complaint channel at orientation; named services do not guarantee an individual safety outcome.
universities.studentSupport: Admissions teams assess category documents, qualification marks and programme preferences. The university publishes student counselling and grievance channels, an Equal Opportunity Cell and scholarship categories including merit, merit-cum-means, sports and Walk-in-Walk-out. Scholarship applications are invited after classes commence and remain subject to selection and current rules.

faq.question: Is this the GreaterNoida university?
faq.answer: No. This profile is Shiv Nadar University Chennai at Kalavakkam, established under Tamil Nadu legislation and separately listed byUGC. The GreaterNoida institution has a distinct legal identity and programme portfolio.

faq.question: What changed for former SSN courses?
faq.answer: The current university FAQ directs 2026 new-entry engineering applicants to SNU Chennai’s SSN School of Engineering. Management likewise enters under SNU Chennai from 2026–27. This does not automatically rename continuing legacy SSN cohorts or transfer their affiliation/accreditation.

faq.question: What UGmarks and subjects are needed?
faq.answer: The verified 2026 engineering route requires Class 10 aggregate 60%, Class 12 aggregate 75%andPhysics, Chemistry, Mathematics. Current qualifying-board completion years and category/equivalence conditions apply; marks below the thresholds cannot be rounded up.

faq.question: How are undergraduate engineering applicants selected?
faq.answer: Applicants rank all 12 branches, complete the required application/SNUCEEslot process and use SNUCEE or the applicable JEE Main shortlisting route, followed by a personal interview. Old SSN government counselling assumptions do not apply to these new university entries.

faq.question: What do MTech applicants need?
faq.answer: Each programme lists accepted qualifying degrees. Common shortlisting requires at least 60%inClass 10, Class 12 andthequalifyingdegree and no current standing backlogs. Some routes require additional programming or environmental-industry experience; selection includes an offline examination and interview.

faq.question: Are MTech programmes fully on campus?
faq.answer: The current page requires the first two semesters in regular on-campus mode. In the second year, the department may approve workplace/industry projects and credited online courses. This is not unconditional permission to study entirely remotely.

faq.question: What is the current MBAentry route?
faq.answer: The 2027–29 page requires a recognised full-time undergraduate degree and more than 60%inClass 10, Class 12 andUG, with an accepted admission-test score and department selection. Published preferred test benchmarks do not guarantee admission.

faq.question: Is English confirmed for every programme?
faq.answer: No. The five preserved undergraduate routes retain their verified English details, andMBA R 2026 specifies English with an authorised-course exception. Other engineering routes leave language unspecified where the programme-specific policy is not established.

faq.question: How should fee categories be compared?
faq.answer: The preserved and new BTech main fees use the specified Foreign/OCI/PIOcategory; separate Indian/NRIcharges differ. NewMTechmainfees use the verified Indian-national rate, with overseas tariffs separately labelled. Hostel, transport, mess, admission and deposits add to tuition.

faq.question: Is the MBAfee current for2027–29?
faq.answer: The retained university schedule states 2026–27 Indian-national annualMBA tuitionINR 300000. It is shown only as an indicative previous-cohort reference for 2027–29 applicants; request the current tariff and complete personal payment schedule.

faq.question: When do programmes begin?
faq.answer: The undergraduate baseline is the university’s planned 2026 Julycommerce/economics andAugustengineering cycle. MTech records 9 July 2026 commencement. The MBA 1 November 2026 notice is an application opening for 2027–29, not the class-start month.

faq.question: Is hostel compulsory?
faq.answer: The verifiedUGbrochure requires choosing university hostel or transport and paying the applicable charges. CurrentMTechstudents may choose residential or non-residential admission; room availability, category and costs need confirmation.
